text: Nora is flying to Auckland on 2 November 2026 to see her sister. Twenty-six hours with a stopover in Singapore, and she's dreading it. She gets restless legs on long flights and can't sleep sitting up. She's staying until early December and then going on to Sydney for a few days with her friend Rana before flying home.
Petra's knee operation is booked for sometime next week. She sounded quite nervous about the general anaesthetic. I should drop her a message the evening before.
Shira got through to the regional final of the piano competition! It's in Leeds early March.
Blessing and Mandla are off to Zanzibar for their anniversary at the end of the month. Two weeks, no laptops, apparently.
Rachel mentioned her dad is having a hip replacement in January 2027. She's taking a week off to look after him and is already worn out thinking about it.
Need to book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.
Marta ran the Berlin marathon in 3:41. Her first one! Must send her a proper congratulations card.
Sofia is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Worth remembering for the dinner.
Eva's daughter Uma is in the school production of Matilda on 12 December 2026. Eva asked if I'd like a ticket; I said yes.
Miriam had her cataract surgery yesterday. She says everything is a bit blurry but the nurse was lovely. Ring her on Friday to see how the eye is doing.

Quick call with Anika. She's moving to Lisbon over the summer for a new job with a design studio. Her partner Hemi is staying in London until his contract ends in September 2027, which she's not thrilled about. She's flying out sometime next week to look at flats and asked if I knew anyone there. I should put her in touch with Carlos, who lived in Lisbon for years.
Rebecca's brother Aidan is playing his first gig with the new band at the Lexington next Thursday. She's going and asked if I fancy it.
Laila hates flying. Her husband booked them a trip to Japan for April 2027 anyway, so she's trying hypnotherapy.
Saskia mentioned, not very subtly, that she'd love a decent pair of noise-cancelling headphones for the long flight to Cape Town. Her birthday is 18 November.
Haruto is recovering at home after his appendix came out last weekend. Still sore, mostly bored. He's watching every season of The Wire.
Remind me to text Rahul good luck before his audition with the orchestra. It's sometime the week of 9 November 2026.

Joanna and her husband have cancelled their trip to Peru. His mum had a fall and is in hospital in Bristol, so they're driving down this weekend instead. Joanna said they'd been planning it since last year and lost most of the deposit, but she's more worried about his mum, who lives alone and is very stubborn about accepting help.
Aneesh plays cricket for a club in Surrey every Saturday over the summer. Bowler, apparently quite fast.
Dentist moved to 3 December 2026 at 9:15. Nothing else this week.

Aditi said her brother Kaito is in hospital with pneumonia. He went in on Tuesday and they're hoping to discharge him by the end of the week. She's been back and forth every day and is exhausted. I should ask if she wants me to pick up the kids from school on Thursday so she can have an afternoon at the hospital without rushing.
Francesca Morris, or Frankie as everyone calls her, is doing a triathlon in Majorca in May 2027. Training six days a week.
Javier's mum has a scan on Monday to check the lump. He's trying to be calm about it but clearly isn't.
Dong told me his cat Biscuit needs an operation on her teeth. The vet quoted him a fortune.
Aiko is back from three weeks in Vietnam and Cambodia. She's got hundreds of photos and wants to show everyone at dinner on Saturday.
Meera passed her driving test this morning! Third attempt. Don't forget to send her something nice.
Carlos and Rana are going to see Hamilton on 22 November 2026. It was her birthday present to him.
Nora's back from New Zealand. Ask her how her sister's wedding went and whether the jet lag has worn off.
Petra is out of hospital and on crutches for six weeks. Her partner is doing all the cooking, which she says is a mixed blessing.
Got the passport renewal form. Must post it sometime next week or I won't have it in time for March 2027.
Shira teaches piano at a primary school in Hackney three days a week and does private lessons on top.
Blessing Okafor rang to say her son is starting at Manchester uni in September 2027. She's thrilled but already sad about him leaving.
Mandla's band is playing a charity gig at the end of the month. He wants as many people as possible there. I'm going with Rachel.

Talked to Marta about her dad. He's had two strokes this year and is now in a care home near Gdansk. She flies out to see him every couple of months and finds it really hard. Next visit is early December. I need to check in with her when she gets back, and maybe offer to water her plants while she's away.

Sofia's cousin Eva is getting married in Seville on 15 May 2027. Sofia's a bridesmaid and is panicking about the speech. She's never spoken in public and wants to practise on a few of us sometime over Christmas. The hen do is in Lisbon in March 2027 and she's organising that too, poor thing. Must offer to help with the speech.
Miriam's grandson Aidan has his grade 5 violin exam sometime next week. She's very proud of him.

Long chat with Uma after the school run. She has a hospital appointment on 4 November 2026 about the migraines. She's been getting them three or four times a week since the summer and her GP finally referred her to a neurologist. She's anxious they'll find something serious. Text her on the morning of the appointment and ask afterwards how it went.
Anika loves Studio Ghibli films and has a whole shelf of the soundtracks on vinyl.
Hemi's half marathon got called off because of the flooding. He's gutted after all that training. They've rescheduled it for early March.
Rebecca Fischer is having her gallbladder out on 27 October 2026. Day surgery, so she'll be home the same evening. Offer to bring food round that weekend.
Laila and Saskia are going to the Glastonbury ballot together. Fingers crossed for June 2027.
Haruto's partner Aiko is pregnant! Due sometime in April 2027. They've just told family.
Rahul's audition went well, he thinks. Results by the end of the month. Must ask him when he hears.
Joanna's mother-in-law is home from hospital. Broken wrist and some bruising, but no surgery needed.
Aneesh mentioned that his wife Aditi is running the London Marathon in April 2027 for a cancer charity. I should sponsor her once the page is up.
Groceries, bin day on Wednesday, and call the council about the parking permit.

Francesca's dog Pepper went missing on Sunday while they were walking on the heath. Still no sign of her. She's posting flyers everywhere. Pepper is a rescue and very skittish, so they think she's hiding somewhere nearby. Francesca's been out every night with a torch and her husband has taken the week off to keep searching. Share the post on the neighbourhood group.
Javier's mum got the all-clear! Benign. He sounded like a different person on the phone.

Dong's flying to Shanghai for his grandmother's ninetieth birthday on 30 November 2026. It's his first trip back in five years. The whole family is flying in from all over, including his cousins from Vancouver. He's bringing her a photo album he's been putting together since the summer. Ask him how it went when he's back in December.

Meera's uncle, Uncle Ravi to everyone, had a heart bypass in Birmingham last Thursday. He's in intensive care but stable. Meera is driving up tomorrow and staying until the weekend. Call her on Sunday to see how he's getting on.
Carlos works as a paramedic and does nights most weeks. Best to message rather than call.
Rana is doing her first stand-up set at an open mic in Peckham on 6 November 2026. She's terrified. Don't forget to text her good luck that afternoon.
Nice coffee with Nora and Petra. Mostly gossip about work. Nothing much to note.
Mandla mentioned his sister Blessing has finally booked her trip to Ghana for over the summer. Six weeks visiting family.
Marta's back from Poland. Her dad was more alert this time, which was a relief. She wants to go again at the end of January.
Shira's recital at the Wigmore Hall is on 14 March 2027. She asked if I'd come and bring my mum.
Booked flights to Rome for 8 to 12 April 2027. Need to sort a hotel near Trastevere sometime next week.

Eva had a really rough flight back from Toronto: eight hours delayed, lost luggage, and a cold she's still fighting off. She's taking the rest of the week off. The trip itself sounded lovely though: her niece Marta's graduation, a weekend at Niagara, and loads of time with her brother. She's planning to go back over the summer next year.
Petra's physio says she can start swimming again early next month. She's itching to get back in the pool. I should invite her for a swim once she's cleared.
Saskia's flight to Cape Town is on 20 December 2026. She'll be away until mid January, so if I want to give her the headphones it has to be before then.
Rachel's dad's operation went fine. He's home now and already complaining about the hospital food. Rachel sounded relieved and is back at work on Monday.
